newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil IBGE sees 79.19 mln tonnes grains/oilseeds.
newsitem.headline: Brazil IBGE sees 79.19 mln tonnes grains/oilseeds.

text.p: Brazilian 1997 production of grains and oilseeds could reach 79.19 million tonnes against 72.98 million tonnes produced in 1996, National Statistics Institute (IBGE) said in a statement.
At the beginning of April, IBGE forecast this year's crop would reach 78.93 million tonnes against 72.81 million tonnes last year.
s estimate, however, is based on some simulations, principally for winter crops such as wheat and for second and third crops of some products, it added.

Soybean production should reach 26.14 million tonnes, a rise of 12.66 percent on last year, while output from the first corn harvest should total 30.57 million tonnes, up 11.61 percent from 1996, the IBGE said. ((-Caroline Bulloch, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 5074151))
